scope_limits: This is deterministic randomized host arithmetic conformance. It does not add a production line-FRI prover, parser, verifier, commitment, or decommitment path.
Query propagation covers sorted/deduplicated indices and local fiber values. It does not draw transcript queries, authenticate Merkle openings, or exercise proof-account framing.
The official Stwo differential covers LineDomain, fold_line, and interpolation outputs for the pinned corpus. It is not an official full FRI proof, VCS, or channel transcript differential.

The 2-per-fold and 4-per-arity4 raw scales are explicit. Selecting normalized versus raw production wire semantics remains a future protocol decision and requires transcript/KAT and soundness synchronization.

The bridge proves the existing natural MLE adjacent-fold order can be retained. It does not implement the genuine circle PCS, circle encoder, OOD relation, statement constraints, hiding, or payment semantics.
